newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: IHC Caland expects 1997 profits up 18 pct. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: IHC Caland expects 1997 profits up 18 pct. [CORRECTED 15:50 GMT]

text.p: Shipbuilding and engineering group IHC Caland NV said on Tuesday it expected 1997 net profit to rise by about 18 percent to 110 million guilders.
The company said its profits per share would grow by 12 percent to 4.12 guilders per share -- at a lower rate than outright profits due to the full impact of additional shares issued in June 1996.
Cash flow would increase significantly in 1997 to about 188 million guilders due to the depreciation of floating oil production and storage units coming into service, it added.
IHC Caland is a supplier of material for the offshore oilfield service, dredging and shipping industries.
It earlier announced preliminary 1996 net profits of 93 million guilders or 3.69 guilders per share. (Corrects from "3.17 guilders per share").
